title: Register and log in with valid university credentials
expected_result: Account is created/authenticated and a secure session is established.

title: Catalogue search returns results within 2 seconds
expected_result: Relevant results and availability are displayed; 95th-percentile response time is at most 2 seconds.

title: User submits a digital access request
expected_result: Request is created as Pending Approval and appears for Admin review; User can view status.

title: Eligible User renews a digital loan
expected_result: Due date is extended according to configured limits and the new due date is shown.

title: User cannot access Admin-only functions
expected_result: System denies access and does not disclose or modify Admin data.

title: Expired digital access is revoked automatically
expected_result: The system detects that the digital loan has expired when the User attempts to access the book. Reading access is denied, the loan status is updated to the appropriate expired or revoked state, and the expiry event is recorded in the audit log.

title: User views loan history and fines
expected_result: Only the User's own accurate loan and fine records are displayed.

title: Audit log records authentication and access-control decisions
expected_result: Successful and failed authentication attempts, access-request decisions, loan renewal, and sanction changes are recorded with actor/system source, timestamp, event type, outcome, and relevant details. A normal User cannot view the audit log.

title: User adds and removes a book from favourites
expected_result: Book appears after adding and no longer appears after removal; list is associated with the correct User.

title: User reads a book with valid approved access
expected_result: Book content opens and can be read through the web interface while access remains valid.

title: User without valid access is denied online reading
expected_result: System denies access and does not expose book content.

title: User requests access again to a previously borrowed book
expected_result: A new access request is created with a visible status after availability and account checks.

title: Repeat borrowing is blocked when book or account is ineligible
expected_result: No invalid request is created; system explains the availability or account restriction.

title: Admin reviews an access request and approves or rejects it
expected_result: Each decision updates the request status, is visible to User, and is recorded in the audit log.

title: Admin applies and removes account sanctions
expected_result: Admin can apply/remove permitted restrictions; access follows account status; each action, reason, and timestamp is logged.

title: Suspended or banned User cannot read digital books
expected_result: Restricted account cannot access protected reading functions; denial is recorded as required.

title: Copyright violation fine follows confirmed severity level
expected_result: The system creates fines of 10,000 VND for Level 1, 20,000 VND for Level 2, and 50,000 VND for Level 3 only after the violations are confirmed. Each fine is linked to its violation record, displays the correct amount and payment status, and is visible to the affected member.

title: Audit log cannot be viewed by a normal User
expected_result: System denies access to audit records; no audit data is disclosed.

title: Member can reserve a book with no available digital copies
expected_result: A reservation is added to the queue and its status is shown to the member. No digital access is granted before a copy becomes available.

title: Member is notified of successful renewal and updated expiry date
expected_result: The system confirms the successful renewal to the member, updates the loan expiry date according to the renewal rules, and records the renewal count. The member can renew the same loan no more than twice.

title: Member is notified when their account is banned due to suspected copyright infringement
expected_result: The system sends a notification informing the member that their account has been banned due to suspected copyright infringement. The notification is associated with the correct member account, and no unrelated member is notified.

title: Audit log records reservation, return, and fine transactions
expected_result: Each reservation action, return/loan closure, and fine creation or adjustment has its own accurate audit record containing actor/system source, timestamp, transaction type, related book/loan/reservation/member, and relevant details. No performed transaction is missing. This test verifies circulation/financial records, not authentication or access-control events.

title: Web forms reject injection and safely encode script input
expected_result: Input is handled as data, not executable SQL or script; no unauthorized data change occurs and no script executes in the browser.
